{{Quote|Talon Two, go skyward in the smoke screen; we'll hit them from above|Myn Donos to Talon Two|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref>}}
"'''Talon Two'''" was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] that flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] for the [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Command]] as part of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]]. This pilot [[Death/Legends|perished]] in an [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambush]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gravan Seven]] by [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]]'s forces.<ref name="WS" />
